welcome.am: እንኳን ወደ MedFinder ኢትዮጵያ በደህና መጡ! 💊 የሚፈልጉትን መድኃኒት ስም ይጻፉ ወይም በድምጽ/በፎቶ ይላኩ።
welcome.or: Baga gara MedFinder Itoophiyaa nagaan dhuftan! 💊 Maqaa qoricha barbaaddanii barreessaa.
welcome.en: Welcome to MedFinder Ethiopia! 💊 Type the medicine name or send a prescription photo.

free_promo_notice.am: 🎉 ልዩ የነጻ ጊዜ ማስተዋወቂያ! እስከ {{free_until}} ድረስ አገልግሎቱ ሙሉ በሙሉ ነጻ ነው።
free_promo_notice.or: 🎉 Yeroo bilaashaa addaa! Hanga {{free_until}}tti tajaajilli kun guutummaatti bilaasha.
free_promo_notice.en: 🎉 Special Free Launch Period! All searches are completely free until {{free_until}}.

paywall_prompt.am: የነጻ ፍለጋ ኮታዎ አልቋል። ፍለጋውን ለመቀጠል በቴሌብር {{amount}} ብር ይክፈሉ ወይም የ25 ብር ወርሃዊ ፓስ ይግዙ።
paywall_prompt.or: Kootaan bilaashaa keessan dhumateera. Itti fufuuf Telebirr dhaan {{amount}} ETB kaffalaa.
paywall_prompt.en: Your free quota has expired. Pay {{amount}} ETB via Telebirr or get a 25 ETB monthly pass.

pharmacy_ping.am: 🚨 አጣዳፊ ጥያቄ፦ አካባቢዎ ያለ ደንበኛ '{{medicine_name}}' ይፈልጋል። ክምችት አለዎት?
pharmacy_ping.or: 🚨 Gaaffii ariifachiisaa: Maamilli naannoo keessanii '{{medicine_name}}' barbaada. Qabduu?
pharmacy_ping.en: 🚨 Urgent Query: Customer nearby needs '{{medicine_name}}'. Do you have stock?
